newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSED MIXED AGAINST HARD UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSED MIXED AGAINST HARD UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier on the U.S. unit and the rand but firmer against sterling and the mark at the close of generally quiet interbank trade on Tuesday, foreign exchange dealers said.

They said the market had been fairly quiet most of the day after an initial currency-buying spree in the morning which prompted the Reserve Bank to inject some cash into the system as a stabilising measure.
"After the Reserve Bank intervened it was a pretty quiet market. There were a couple of receipts which were enough to take care of whatever payments were going out," one dealer commented.

He said the local dollar still closed marginally easier against the U.S. unit at 10.7500/7700 compared to its overnight 10.7450/7650 and was at 2.3395/3464 against South Africa's rand, down from 2.3300/3500.
On the crosses however the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer, edging up to 17.9375/9816 from 18.0300/0500 against pound sterling and to 7.0372/0526 on the German mark from Monday's 7.0800/1000 close.
